intent: Sustained forward trot at 0.1 m/s on Sesame's 8-joint (2-DoF/leg) vertical-axis hips, using direct smooth joint curves with diagonal pairs A=(RF,LR) and B=(RR,LF) half-cycle offset; distinct gait variant from prior candidates.

phases.name: stance A / swing B (early)
phases.base_motion: Constant forward velocity 0.1 m/s along world x, y=0, constant base height 0.04673357 m, zero roll/pitch/yaw.
phases.limb_motion: Pair A hips sweep from cos peak toward zero (stance, knee flex ~0.150 rad); pair B swings with normalized arch knee lift up to ~0.560 rad; R3=L4=pi-flexA, R4=L3=flexB.

phases.name: stance A / swing B (late)
phases.base_motion: Same constant forward velocity and constant base height.
phases.limb_motion: Pair A continues stance sweep to cos trough; pair B swing arch descends toward touchdown, knee flex returning to stance bias.

phases.name: stance B / swing A (early)
phases.base_motion: Same constant forward velocity and constant base height.
phases.limb_motion: Pair B now in stance with knee flex ~0.150 rad; pair A swings with normalized arch knee lift; diagonal knee mapping preserved.

phases.name: stance B / swing A (late)
phases.base_motion: Same constant forward velocity and constant base height.
phases.limb_motion: Pair B stance sweep completes; pair A swing arch descends to touchdown, knee flex back to stance bias, closing the cycle smoothly.

coding_notes: Parameters (distinct from candidates 026-029): freq=2.52 Hz, hip amplitude A=0.268 rad, hip center=1.605 rad, stance knee flex=0.150 rad, swing knee lift=0.560 rad, phase origin=0.112, base height=0.04673357 m. Compute pA=freq*t+phase0 then pA-=floor(pA); pB=pA+0.5 then pB-=floor(pB). cA=cos(2*pi*pA), cB=cos(2*pi*pB). Hips: R1=center+A*cA; R2=pi-center+A*cB; L1=pi-center-A*cB; L2=center-A*cA. Swing flags pA>=0.5, pB>=0.5; normalized sA=(pA-0.5)*2, sB=(pB-0.5)*2; archA=sin(pi*sA), archB=sin(pi*sB); flexA=where(swingA, stance_flex+swing_lift*archA, stance_flex); flexB likewise. Knees: R3=pi-flexA, L4=pi-flexA, R4=flexB, L3=flexB. Stack q=[R1,R3,R2,R4,L1,L3,L2,L4] dim=-1. root_pos_w=[speed*t, 0*t, base_z*(1+0*t)]; root_rpy=zeros. contacts=[pA<0.5, pB<0.5, pB<0.5, pA<0.5] for RF,RR,LF,LR. No clipping, no base ripple, no loops/imports; use m.sin/cos/floor/where/stack and 0*t broadcasts.
